# Quest Board

Quest Board turns your real to-do list into a game, now packaged as a real Muse skill. Start with three quests from your actual list, each filed under a life sphere (Personal, Work, Health, Admin, or your own). Completed quests earn 10 XP when small, 25 XP when medium and 50 XP when hard; every 150 XP is a new level, and each level carries a humorous title, from Task Goblin at level 1 to Chronomancer at level 5. A quest can carry a deadline (a date, optionally a time) that you can set, move or clear at any time, and the board always puts the earliest deadline first. A completion each day keeps your streak alive, every Monday brings one weekly boss, a hard quest worth double XP, and finished quests move to a separate archive you can browse or reopen, so the active board stays focused on what remains.

The listing installs the packaged SKILL.md and LICENSE from Skill Harbor's public house-skills repository. It is a Skill Harbor house build, free to use under the proprietary Skill Harbor House License v1.0, all rights reserved. It stays fun and light, and it never invents your starter quests: the game is built from tasks you supply.
